6 November · La Paz – Tiwanaku – Puno – Uros

Have breakfast at the hotel, then travel from La Paz via Tiwanaku to the Peruvian border at Desaguadero. Continue by transfer to your hotel in Puno. In the afternoon, visit the Uros Islands on Lake Titicaca. Overnight in Puno.

We head towards the Peruvian border, where the famous Lake Titicaca lies. Along the way, we visit the ruins of Tiwanaku, the remains of one of South America’s oldest civilisations. You’ll see the Gateway of the Sun, the Kalasasaya Temple and the pyramids, monuments to Tiwanaku’s past. The people of Tiwanaku were skilled in agriculture, water management, architecture and medicine, and developed complex forms of social organisation. Natural disasters, including prolonged droughts, brought about the civilisation’s collapse near the end of the first millennium AD. Its disappearance remains a mystery. The tour ends at the Peruvian border in Desaguadero, where you’ll meet your transfer to your hotel in Puno.
In the afternoon, visit the Uros reed islands with an English-speaking guide. Learn about the lake communities’ traditional way of life, customs, beliefs and clothing.
